## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `--exclude` flag needs to take its default from the `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` environment variable, because the project's CLI flag rules require that for every new flag and CI sets options through the environment.

## Changes
The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that skips files whose base name matches any of the patterns. The change adds an `is_excluded` helper and threads the patterns through `collect` and `main`. It also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md` and adds tests for parsing, collection and the archive output.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the --exclude default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — The new flag hard-codes `default=[]`, so running with `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` set still archives `.log` files. This breaks `.claude/skills/cli-flags/reference.md:5`: "Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable". — CI jobs that set exclusions through the environment silently get no exclusions and archive files they meant to skip. — Fix: Build the default from `os.environ.get("ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE")`, splitting it on a documented separator, then update the `none` default in `docs/flags.md:7` and extend `test_exclude_defaults_to_nothing` to cover the variable.
